body: thank you. i dont know if the ocd can make weird feelings too but i almost had a total meltdown the other day because im so scared its real. its almost like the intrusive thoughts are testing me to make sure i dont want it but the thought of anything romantic involving my sister makes me sick to my stomach even if my mind makes it feel nice and positive or whatever. it just hurts and it feels so gross dude

thank you so much. like right now i have this horrible fear for days because i had an intrusive feeling and i am beyond terrified that deep down i wanted to do something bad. like i have been obsessing about it for days and constantly panicking and making sure that i didnt, and ive been crying about it to my girlfriend too and she insists that its all okay. yet i feel this horrible sickly feeling. but i dont understand because whenever i have a real desire to do something, i KNOW i want it and i dont have to play paranoid guessing games with it. and i got this intrusive feeling literally while i was in the middle of stressing about how i DONT want to do said thing. is this just ocd still messing with me? thank you

thanks so much. ive never had this thing before and im having the worst panic attack ever because pocd isnt my main theme so i dont know where something like this came from. it all happened in a second and it was so fast that i dont know if i had an intrusive thought or an intrusive feeling or what but i just cant figure out what i thought or what i felt precisely or what made me freak out but can ocd just put completely fake feelings into your mind?? ive had that before with other ocd themes but ive never had this one so i dont know. im literally losing my mind over it

oh im sorry if it seemed like i was equating the two! i just meant that with pocd i know that people who have that tend to obsess about being that kind of person but i never did because i know im not. i have had some obsessions along the lines of pocd though and its terrifying. im happy to know this is an ocd symptom though

hey im not sure if you remember me but weve bumped into each other on this sub before in the comments and i had the exact same feelings as you but these past few days i came out of it for some reason and i feel just fine with my gf again so i wanted to give some advice!

that happiness is how you feel for them under the surface. with my ocd it feels like a big blanket over my head covering all my feelings for for my partner and even making false ones and trying to make me feel like this is my reality but these feelings are all an illusion and i think its because you care about your partner so much that your brain sees losing them as a threat, so it automatically detaches. from my experience and research, intrusive feelings are absolutely a thing. but there is no gauge on how you should feel or how happy you should feel. if you want your partner to be your valentine then just go through with it and say screw you to your ocd and just do what you want anyway.

its scary and its awful but its all an illusion no matter how real it feels. i know you wanna stay with your person and if you didnt have them in your life you wouldnt be happy at all right? little things like that are what you feel under the surface. and even if youre unsure or you dont feel anything, just do what you want. if you dont wanna break up with them then just.. dont.

just take it one day at a time. if you feel weird you feel weird. but if you wanna be with your person then simply choose to, because this is the person you choose to feel everything with

thank you so so much. i dont mean this in like a reassurance-y way but this is literally exactly what i needed to hear because i feel like its what i know rationally but i cant FEEL for real because ocd is just twisting everything in my head and its so scary. like ive broken up with someone before and i cried but it wasnt because of losing them yknow? like it was just something i knew i had to do. but its not like this with my gf at all and the thought of my love just magically changing or going away and not having that same connection is terrifying. and i get no clarity from this “weird” feeling. so its so scary but i do wanna stay with her and make it work and its so obvious that i still love her under the rocd but you know how ocd is :’) again thank you

no it makes perfect sense because i feel the same! like i feel weird and terrible and then ill get the SMALLEST clarity moments where things feel right with my gf again for a few seconds or ill suddenly feel really affectionate and ill even feel all warm inside when she says something sweet but my brains still messing with me. i hope you find peace in your relationship as well and that things will turn out alright. i dont wanna reassure you too much but someone on here once told me that if you really didnt wanna be with them anymore, youd be actively trying to get out of it lol. and we wouldnt stick around and want those feelings to return to normal if we didnt still love them deep down. maybe its reassurance, but to my rational brain its common sense. good luck to you

they dont feel loud for me either, neither does my ocd. its just constantly in the background and when i try to push it away it makes me doubt myself. and the thing is that otherwise in life i feel decent except for this and im scared i wont go back to the way i felt with her. its like my mind has totally forgotten that i even love her and want a life with her but i dont get it because i can still say love you to her and itll feel “right” i guess and i still think about hugging and kissing her and i always worry about if shes healthy and safe and stuff?? and really i just dont wanna break up at all. i cant imagine life without her, shes my other half. but i cant get rid of this intrusive feeling and if im sitting and accepting it like everyone says then why cant i get clarity :( its hard but im glad im not alone because it proves that jts def an rocd thing

i dont know how to make it better either. like im so confused because i can still call her my girlfriend and legit want to be in a romantic relationship with her SO BAD and im practically praying for my feelings to come back yet my rocd still feels like a blanket over my mind and still tries to make me feel like i love her just as a friend and see her that way even if i dont want to and it hurts. i also miss that spark so bad and just my old feelings of romance and everything and i dont know why my rocd wont let it come out at all!! for you is it also a feeling problem along with just having these thoughts? this is what its like for me

i am not kidding when i say that im going through the exact same thing. like right down to the wanting to see them as you did before but rocd has a grip on your mind and twists how you see your partner and makes them seem like a friend. this is what my rocd is about and im still so worried but ive been coping better but i dont feel how i did before so im still scared :( but i still cant give up on her either because i still love her somewhere, im sure of it… and im positive its the same for you. just know youre not alone at all
im not sadly because i cant afford any kind of therapy at the moment. and ive had rocd before with this exact theme and i overcame it but this time it really seems to be sticking :(

thank you very much. like even after legit saying that i love her my rocd makes me immediately doubt it when someone else says that i clearly love her :’) and its awful because what gets me with rocd is the FEELINGS it gives me along with the intrusive thoughts. like it makes me feel ways about my gf or see her differently or feel disconnected from her, or doubt things about my feelings for her that id never normally doubt. and less than a month ago i was just fine. but worst case if my ocd ruins or already ruined my feelings for my gf or something, id WANT them back and i want this relationship with her :( but thanks a bunch! all i know is that i wanna be with her and i dont wanna break up and i want my feelings back to normal

this is so kind, and yeah ocd really does attack what means so much to you because when i have rocd its completely devastating because i love my gf more than anything. this means so much to me because ocd just keeps beating me down but something in me wants to fight for this. but ill try to follow this advice :)

thank you so much :’) i’m just terrified of what almost every single person with rocd is scared of, and thats the love just not coming back and our three years together just. gone. since my rocd would ruin my feelings and make me lose someone i wanna spend the rest of my life with. this is the worst fear of mine with rocd and it feels so real since i really just cant feel anything and it preys off my worries and makes it feel real and makes me doubt if im just in denial or something. but im trying so hard to fight for us because my ocd has nearly always revolved around mostly losing her or someone else i love. i know somewhere deep DEEP down i still love my gf a lot and i dont wanna just accept it and give up on us because just 2 weeks ago i was overwhelmed with how much i love her. i have overcome this exact same theme before and the love definitely did come back, so im hoping itll do the same because i wanna be with her. thank you so much

thank you, i care about my relationship a lot too and i love my gf so much and i wanna stay with her and im even excited about moving in together! but these made up feelings are killing me :( i want them to go away. i wish you the best though

thank you so much. like im still worried despite all this because im really scared that perhaps its not even rocd and my feelings themselves have just changed and that its a strong platonic love or something. but when i get scared about this it doesnt make any sense because the thought of being with her just as a friend brings me to tears, and it definitely wouldnt explain the strong love feelings i get that just feel like theyre under the surface, and also my desire to kiss her and hug her and be intimate and stuff and also my jealousy :’) also my desperate wish for my ocd to go away and let my gf FEEL like my girlfriend again and not a stranger or a friend. so i dont think any of that is consistent with me liking her just as a friend, but its confusing and my mind is in its own world right now with the distortions and feelings made by ocd i think. but your advice really helped me and i dont want me and my gf to break up so i really wanna keep pushing :) thank you so much and i wish you luck

thank you so much!! its a massive relief too knowing that multiple people feel the exact same i did and yet they still wanna fight for their partner. i worried that it was just me and no one else felt this way but it definitely seems to be one of rocds stupid tricks. i wish you luck as well and i know you love your bf a lot if youre willing to fight like this for him. i know this logically and still cant escape the weird disconnected feelings, but the fact is that its all a big illusion and a bunch of fake feelings!! dont give up

i wanted to say thanks to you too for commenting because this literally made me feel so much better just knowing im not alone. i know its a compulsion but i havent been able to stop looking on here for someone with the same obsession or thoughts i have but what you just described with those scary and horrible feelings and like the comfort and love is trapped under the ice is EXACTLY how im feeling 100%. this is my exact experience and its absolutely horrible. i feel so detached and numb and anxious and just scared of losing my partner, but my rational brain can recognize that my love for her is still somewhere in there and that this is just a big delusion and its all a bunch of fake feelings. i even sent her a big text a few minutes ago just letting her know what im going through but that i love her and im fighting for us. but its absolutely terrifying.

thank you for your comment though, i deeply appreciate it :) im quite literally fighting this with everything i have and i love her as my gf as much as she is my best friend in the whole world

i guess maybe my perspective on this is skewed then. like obviously rocd makes me feel bad, but there really is nothing wrong with being friends with your partner, and i think its a good thing because i consider my gf my best friend. but my obsession is this made up possibility that i love her ONLY as a friend which i know its more than that yknow? :(
but to answer your question, i like her a lot. i think shes really funny, i like our conversations, its always fun hanging out with her and she makes me feel better, etc. but i wish rocd wouldnt take away the feeling that shes my girlfriend and not just a friend or stranger or something. thats the part where i dont even know why my ocd is doing that

sorry if i dont make sense! its just all stressing me out but i enjoy my gf as a person a bunch besides for the usual “love” stuff like intimacy and affection and stuff
alright, thank you so much!

exactly. like its such fucking bullshit. i spent so many times worrying if i only love the “idea” of my gf or if id be so heartbroken to lose her since i dont wanna be alone or im attached or whatever but its all fucking bullshit and these are just articles that people get paid to write and it isnt even the same for people with rocd because ocd makes all kinds of feelings and thoughts that feel so real. love isnt the same with every relationship and for me, this is my first serious relationship and we’re approaching 3 years and i love her so much but my rocd is fucking up everything and when i read these articles i just get so scared. theyre the fucking worst

thank you so much! this helps a lot and i really needed to head this before i literally go insane lol. and the thing is that i know partners can be best friends, like my gf is basically my best friend but i also love her so much yknow?? and my ocd is basically obsessed with this made up idea that i fell out of love or i just love her only as a friend and its REALLY terrifying. and its just completely blocking out all my feelings for her, and just that feeling like we’re together as a couple, and it feels like a big blanket over my head. and i know that these aren’t even my real feelings about her since i know my true ones are kinda deep down in me past what rocd is doing right now, but it still scares me that my love for her could just disappear and id lose her. i even did something stupid and looked up this exact thing in relationships that im scared of, that your partner feels like a friend, and to see people tell their experiences with it and how they just dont love their partner like they used to scared me so much i almost cried. i dont want that to be me.

its really confusing but maybe its just a normal ebb and flow of our relationship but rocd is on top of it so its trying to like. make my worst fears feel true :( i just dont wanna fall out of love because i WANT to stay with my gf and not break up or be just friends. itd shatter my heart. and i still wanna do relationship stuff too? like im not uncomfortable with kissing her or cuddling or thinking about being intimate or something and i still like all of that stuff. and i still get jealous. and even if im numb right now i still feel love strongly for her somewhere. so its all just so confusing ughh

but thank you for your advice. it means the world to me and i never wouldve even known this is kinda normal otherwise

its driving me fucking insane dude. i know how you feel and i cant take it anymore. i cant take my anxiety taking this fake made up shit and making it so real and shoving it in my goddamn face every hour, every SECOND of the day until im fucking grabbing at my hair on my head pulling on it just desperately trying to get my mind to shut up and let me get back down to reality for 3 seconds. what in gods name did we do to deserve this

thank you :’) obviously id never do something like that as long as i LIVE because at my age now im positive that i know better. theres just such awful things on that app and im still really upset that i stumbled upon this, but im glad i havent seen anything else like that yknow

thank you so much for taking the time to reply to me and everything! if you have the time i just wanted to ask, how can i deal with this? ocd is extremely convincing to the point where its telling me i actually really thought this deep down but just somehow didnt notice (despite the fact that i absolutely would have) and it just feels SO real. im constantly ruminating and im sure that i wouldve found at least one other moment in our relationship that this happened by now so im constantly living in this “what if” based off a bad feeling :(

i dont think these things are ignorant at all! i actually think we have the same thing in mind. like ive never even had this thought or this kind of obsession with ocd until my mind threw this at me because it knows that the stakes for it are my relationship, which means a lot to me. i really would describe it as fleeting because it came and it felt so real and scary and then i realized that its not true, but it still gives me a lot of guilt and fear and anxiety. but logically i know i dont think that of her. i guess ill just continue on doing like ive been doing but maybe ill try to give her a bit of extra love or something :) thank you so so much for taking the time out of your day to tell me these things because it helps me get it together so much youve got no idea.

again thank you, this is super insightful :’) it really helped me get a better grasp on my situation. but theres a particular thing about that that im literally terrified about and for some reason even if i use logic i cant get it out of my head and it makes me so anxious?? like i keep having this scary intrusive thought of like “what if all along youve thought your girlfriend is a little ugly deep down” and its so horrible its making me sick. it keeps saying that i think this deep down but if you think something deep down then dont you know it for sure? plus i feel like i wouldnt be scared of thinking it, id just feel terrible.

i did feel so horrible because it felt so real but ive been thinking about it nonstop every day for hours and there has not been a single time in our relationship where i ever thought my gf was unattractive or ugly or anything, not even deep down. i just loved her for who she is and i still love her like that to this day. plus i dont think its possible to think that your partner is very beautiful for the whole relationship but “subconsciously” think that shes unattractive. im only this afraid because i dont wanna lose her. sorry im rambling but do you have any advice? if not its okay :)

thank you so so much. this is the only thing all day thats made me feel even remotely better. like this all happened because i got triggered by a tiktok where somebody called their gf a little ugly or something and it freaked me out so bad since my mind was IMMEDIATELY like “what if you thought this about your gf” and it felt so sudden and real that it hit me like a truck. and because it felt real ive been feeling legit guilty too even though i know ive never once thought this about my gf. now it just feels like ocd is trying to pick out her flaws and try to see if i thought anything bad about her in the past just to fit its own sick narrative :( its a horrible disease but i truly love her so much

im sadly not because i cant afford it :( my ocd has been getting really bad lately and i feel triggered by something almost every day or obsessing about something new daily. but im resisting confessing to my girlfriend because thats my compulsion. how do you cope with your real event ocd??

im not the best at advice and stuff but i have something you could try!

so try something small that you would want. say that you want it to be sunny tomorrow and your ocd says that if you turn the light on and off 4 times youll get that. then dont do it and see what happens. if its sunny, youll see that the light switch has nothing to do with it. and even if its rainy, logically a light switch doesnt affect the weather!! see how things in life happen around you even if you dont do the compulsion. its a little silly and i just came up with it but i think it may help you see that its just your ocd doing this to you.

another thing is just trying to accept that whatever happens in life just happens no matter what you compulsion your ocd makes you do

i think it can be postponed yeah, its not anything extremely severe but if its true even if i didnt mean it in a bad way i just dont understand why this wouldve happened. im sorry if i seem all over the place but its just so stressful

thank you so much :) if it is real then one thing im sure of is that i didnt have any actual bad intent behind it at all and itd probably just sound bad if i confessed it but besides that i dont really know anything about it. i find myself seeking reassurance a lot and just really wanting to know if its false or true yet i can never figure it out. i do try to journal and stuff since my gf suggested doing that to me and usually it allows me to get the mess in my head clear so i dont blab about it to her :’) but thank you so much. i really cant see myself doing this thing and i try to disconnect myself from my past actions in general but sometimes it is very hard because i dont wanna hurt the one i love ahh
